description: Tidy SQL into readable, indented lines, or minify it onto one line. Works with common dialects such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite and SQL Server.

input.description: Path to a file to read instead of text.

keyword_case.description: How to write keywords. Defaults to upper.

minify.description: Put the query on one line and drop comments.

output.description: Save the result to this file instead of returning it.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

text.description: The text itself. Use this or input.

name: sql_format
title: Format SQL
